title: Nuclei Extraction from Flash-Frozen Grafted Mouse Brains for 10X Genomics Single-Cell Sequencing
author: Roberto Garcia Swinburn
materials: Euthanasia : Euthanize animals via cervical dislocation.
Equilibration : Equilibrate brains to -20°C before slicing.

steps.title: Extract the Brain
steps.instruction: Promptly extract the whole brain immediately after confirmed death.

substeps.instruction: Use scissors or scalpels to open the skin and expose the skull
Use blunt forceps to lift the detached skull, exposing the brain
Use scissors or bone rongeurs to cut the skull between the eyes and into the ears from the back
Remove the brain using a spoon or spatula by slowly detaching the nerves

steps.title: Flash-Freeze and Store Brains
steps.instruction: Flash-freeze the extracted brains and store them at appropriate temperatures.

substeps.instruction: Submerge brains in dry-ice chilled isopentane for 10–15 seconds to flash-freeze
Transfer flash-frozen brains to -80°C for storage (or liquid nitrogen for very long term storage)

steps.title: Prepare BSA-Coated Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare and pre-coat collection tubes to prevent nuclei loss.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1% Nuclease-free BSA in sterile nuclease-free PBS1X
Pre-coat 2 and 0.5 mL LoBind Eppendorf tubes with 1% BSA overnight at 4°C
Briefly rinse tubes with sterile-filtered 1X PBS before use

steps.title: Section the Brain
steps.instruction: Slice the frozen brain into coronal sections using a cooled environment.

substeps.instruction: Place brains in a -20°C cooled slicing chamber and stabilize using a brain matrix
Use chilled razor blades to slice brains into four 1-mm thick coronal sections (2 slices anterior and 2 slices posterior to the center of the graft implantation site)

steps.title: Punch Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Collect target tissue from the coronal sections.

substeps.instruction: Use 1 mm biopsy punchers to punch dorsal striatum (where graft is expected) from each slice
Collect punches into the pre-prepared BSA-coated tubes

steps.title: Isolate Nuclei
steps.instruction: Perform nuclei isolation using the 10X Genomics Chromium Nuclei Isolation Kit (1000494) following the manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Proceed to GEM Preparation
steps.instruction: Continue the GEM preparation immediately after nuclei isolation.
